title: JANUS Linear A SigLA ↔ mwenge document identity bridge specification v0.1
question: How much document overlap can be established by a single predeclared source-syntax transform that removes only SigLA ASCII spaces while preserving every epigraphically meaningful or potentially meaningful marker?

SIGLA.rule: If the live page no longer has the frozen SHA-256, execution must stop and a new inventory freeze must be created instead of silently using changed data.

bridge_transform.name: SIGLA_REMOVE_ASCII_SPACES_ONLY
SIGLA_operations_in_order: trim leading and trailing Unicode whitespace
remove every ASCII SPACE U+0020 inside the identifier
MWENGE_operations_in_order: trim leading and trailing Unicode whitespace

predeclared_outputs: transform collision counts and collision members
prefix/site distribution of matched and unmatched IDs

gates.B1_SNAPSHOT: SigLA bytes SHA-256 must exactly equal the parent inventory snapshot hash.
gates.B2_COUNT: SigLA extraction must return exactly 802 distinct document IDs.
gates.B3_COLLISIONS: Any transformed-ID collision is preserved; collided IDs are excluded from one-to-one bridge matches and block calling the entire transform bijective.
gates.B4_MATCH_RULE: A bridge match exists only when the transformed SigLA ID exactly equals a transformed mwenge ID and both transformed keys are collision-free.
gates.B5_NO_POSTHOC_EXTENSION: Unmatched residues must remain unmatched in this execution. A different transform requires a new frozen bridge spec.
gates.B6_CLAIM_CEILING: Document ID bridging may establish cross-digitization document identity for matched keys only; it cannot establish transcription agreement, independent epigraphic replication, lexical meaning, anchor novelty, or decipherment.

interpretation_policy.high_overlap: Supports using the collision-free matched subset for a later content-level cross-digitization audit.
interpretation_policy.low_overlap: Does not imply different archaeological corpora; it means whitespace removal alone is insufficient and a separately frozen metadata/bibliographic bridge is needed.
interpretation_policy.unmatched_examples_such_as_GO_2a_vs_GO2r: Remain unresolved regardless of apparent human plausibility.
